name: The Archaists
diagnosis: The world before the Silence was real, and losing it is the wound everything else grows from.
prescription: Restore it exactly as it was, because they cannot imagine anything that was not already here.

name: The Diadochoi
diagnosis: The Incumbent has lost its grip, and the wrong hands hold the reins.
prescription: Take the same methods into their own hands, so the suffering only changes who it falls on.

name: The Isonomoi
diagnosis: Power held by a few rots whoever holds it, and the rot is real.
prescription: Hold power equally or not at all, whatever it costs the order that keeps people alive.
